_about: The Vercel firewall for the project hrizzup (all environments), applied and read back by apply.py. Rules run top to bottom. Rate limits count per visitor IP address over 60 seconds and answer 429 when exceeded. Blueprint section 9: every route that signs in or sends email is rate-limited. Our routes that sign in live under /auth/, and any route of ours that sends email must live under /auth/email/ or /api/email/ so these rules cover it; the typed API's calls that send email live under /api/v1/auth/email/, which staging's own rule limits the same way (production's waits for the pre-launch checklist, P.14). (Email codes requested straight from Supabase Auth are limited by Supabase itself and by Turnstile: infra/supabase/auth/settings.json.) A rule whose every condition group names one of staging's own domains as the host (staging.hrizzup.com) reaches only staging; apply.py --staging-only applies a firewall change only when every rule it adds, changes or removes is such a rule and its action stays with the request it matches (no persistent action, no bypass of the DDoS mitigations).

rules.name: Rate limit: routes that send email
rules.description: At most 5 requests a minute per IP to any route that sends email.

rules.name: Rate limit: sign-in
rules.description: At most 20 requests a minute per IP to the sign-in routes (/auth/).

rules.name: Rate limit: health page
rules.description: At most 60 requests a minute per IP to /api/health.

rules.name: Health page: no bot challenge
rules.description: Uptime monitors and the release pipeline read /api/health without a browser. It holds no data and is rate-limited by the rule above.

rules.name: Rate limit: staging's typed API calls that send email
rules.description: At most 5 requests a minute per IP to staging's typed API calls that send email (/api/v1/auth/email/ on staging.hrizzup.com), as for every route that sends email. Staging only.

rules.name: Rate limit: staging's typed API
rules.description: At most 60 requests a minute per IP to staging's typed API (/api/v1/ on staging.hrizzup.com). Staging only.

rules.name: Rate limit: staging's perp jobs
rules.description: At most 30 requests a minute per IP to staging's perp jobs address (/api/jobs/perps on staging.hrizzup.com), which Supabase Cron calls 13 times a minute. Staging only.

rules.name: Rate limit: staging's API docs
rules.description: At most 60 requests a minute per IP to staging's public API docs (/docs, /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt on staging.hrizzup.com), which AI tools read without a browser. Staging only.

rules.name: Staging's typed API: no bot challenge
rules.description: The app reads staging's typed API without a browser, so it can't pass the bot challenge (PLAN.md step 1.5d). Reads only (GET), rate-limited by the rules above; the app's writes have the rule below. Staging only. Keep bypasses last.

rules.name: Staging's typed API: the app's writes, no bot challenge
rules.description: The app writes to staging's typed API without a browser (PLAN.md step 1.6b: it asks for email codes there), so it can't pass the bot challenge. POST only, rate-limited by the rules above. Staging only. Keep bypasses last.

rules.name: Staging's perp jobs: no bot challenge
rules.description: Supabase Cron calls staging's perp jobs address from the database, not a browser (PLAN.md step 3.4a). POST only; the address needs the jobs' secret, and the rule above limits it. Staging only. Keep bypasses last.

rules.name: Staging's API docs: no bot challenge
rules.description: AI tools and bots read staging's API docs (/docs, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt) without a browser (PLAN.md step 3.5a). Reads only (GET), rate-limited by the rule above. Staging only. Keep bypasses last.
